headline: Target: beat MIND SOTA zetik 0.7326 (currently 0.7144, #14). JEV Campaign-1 SFT trained on MIND_small (COMPLETED); dev eval running.

campaigns.name: JEV-4B Campaign-1: SFT (MIND small → large)
campaigns.motivation: Stock OpenJev is a frozen 'no-UL' ranking model (0.6432 AUC) that never saw MIND news. Fine-tune it to P(yes) on MIND pointwise samples to build a news-specialized ranking model — the foundation the RLCD / RL / Teacher-OPD campaigns build on.
campaigns.settings: Qwen3.5 stacked linear-attn JEV-4B · noul A/B prompt · plain pointwise SFT CE on the answer token (R-Drop self-KL collapsed to chance 0.4975 and was removed) · sdpa · micro-batch 2 · lr 1e-4 · DS ZeRO-2 · abstract, hist30, neg1.0, cutoff4096
campaigns.data: MIND_small first (fast validation loop) → re-scale to MINDlarge once signal is confirmed
campaigns.eval: run_jev_eval.py noul scorer on dev@5000 → recompute pointwise AUC vs stock JEV 0.6432

campaigns.name: JEV-4B Campaign-2: RLCD
campaigns.motivation: Distill click preferences without an online reward model: score candidates with the Campaign-1 model, build contrastive prefs, fine-tune to raise P(A) on preferred vs dispreferred (DPO-style).
campaigns.settings: DPO-style contrastive distillation from SFT-JEV self-scores · noul A/B contract

campaigns.name: JEV-4B Campaign-3: RL (GRPO)
campaigns.motivation: Reinforcement learning from a pointwise reward over noul A/B responses on the Campaign-1 checkpoint, reusing the existing verl/GRPO + vLLM infra.
campaigns.settings: verl GRPO · reward_type=pointwise_binary / mind_auc · vLLM rollout · on C1 checkpoint

campaigns.name: JEV-4B Campaign-4: Teacher OPD
campaigns.motivation: Offline preference distillation from a strong external teacher (our L1.3 1.7B best pointwise ranker) into JEV-4B — a real, distinct teacher signal (unlike the failed within-model R-Drop).
campaigns.settings: KL-to-frozen-teacher logits term on JEV noul format · β≈0.1
